scope: all existing S9b client requests over500ms plus every HTTP/client/postverify error, local frozen evidence only; no new Oracle, DB call or load
interpretation_limits: Different-stage percentiles are not additive. Per-request additive stage clocks are used for attribution.
DB read wall time includes the existing driver, network and Neo4j result hydration; it is not isolated Neo4j server CPU time.
Executor non-DB residual is wall time outside observed _read calls; it can include Python/JSON processing, derived SQLite view IO and scheduling. No profiler isolated these causes.
self has no DB-stage observer in this run. Missing self DB metrics remain null; they are not estimated as zero.
Native request_time has millisecond resolution; frontend-minus-sidecar/client differences are approximate.
A slow request may wait behind other requests with long driver or CPU stages. Its own measured driver time alone does not rule out such indirect contention.

early_wave_observations.causal_limit: Descriptive co-occurrence only; no new causal experiment was performed.
